  v3-product-cross-repository-checks:
    name: v3-product-cross-repository-checks
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 25
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      GOTOOLCHAIN: local
      GOWORK: 'off'
      GOFLAGS: '-mod=readonly'
      GOTELEMETRY: 'off'
      GOMAXPROCS: '2'
      IU_BOT_CANDIDATE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      # Publication is blocked until this is replaced by the reviewed Encoder
      # candidate containing its actual HTTP process helper and frozen manifest.
      IU_ER_CANDIDATE_SHA: '7c7ec14d2b06b866ebd5b006331f55ba01da8dfe'
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: bot
        shell: bash
    steps:
      - name: Checkout exact Bot candidate
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.IU_BOT_CANDIDATE_SHA }}
          path: bot
          fetch-depth: 0
          submodules: recursive
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Require a frozen Encoder candidate
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$IU_ER_CANDIDATE_SHA" != 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000
          test "${#IU_ER_CANDIDATE_SHA}" = 40
      - name: Checkout exact Encoder candidate
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          repository: Kome-Lab/Autostream-Encoder-Recorder
          ref: ${{ env.IU_ER_CANDIDATE_SHA }}
          path: encoder
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-go@b7ad1dad31e06c5925ef5d2fc7ad053ef454303e # v7.0.0
        with:
          go-version: '1.26.5'
          check-latest: false
          cache: false
      - name: Verify both tested source trees and the same immutable shared pin
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$IU_BOT_CANDIDATE_SHA"
          test "$(git -C ../encoder rev-parse HEAD)" = "$IU_ER_CANDIDATE_SHA"
          test "$(go env GOVERSION)" = go1.26.5
          git log -1 --format='Bot tested commit: %H%nBot tested tree: %T'
          git -C ../encoder log -1 --format='Encoder tested commit: %H%nEncoder tested tree: %T'
          python3 scripts/ci/iu-source-boundary.py
          python3 scripts/ci/iu-module-pin.py a05e4d24bc9ffef54244dc5424b32d090f87e849 --download
          (cd ../encoder && python3 scripts/ci/iu-source-boundary.py)
          (cd ../encoder && python3 scripts/ci/iu-module-pin.py 8c17e7389ccdb3429f1e59a1a6147b27fe3c3793 --download)
      - name: Actual Bot HTTP client to independent Encoder process, Native and Race
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          export IU_WS3_ER_SOURCE="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/encoder"
          for mode in native race; do
            flags=()
            if test "$mode" = race; then
              flags=(-race)
              export CGO_ENABLED=1
            else
              export CGO_ENABLED=0
            fi
            export IU_WS3_ER_BINARY="$RUNNER_TEMP/iu-encoder-http-$mode.test"
            (cd ../encoder && go test -p 1 "${flags[@]}" -tags=iu_crossrepo -c ./internal/httpapi -o "$IU_WS3_ER_BINARY")
            go test -p 1 "${flags[@]}" -tags=iu_crossrepo -count=1 -timeout=5m -json ./internal/audioforward -run '^TestIUWS3CrossRepositoryBotEncoder$' | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/iu-cross-repository-$mode.json"
            python3 scripts/ci/iu-json-events.py scripts/ci/ws3-crossrepo-required-tests.txt "$RUNNER_TEMP/iu-cross-repository-$mode.json"
            for name in actual_raw_and_queue stale_vector_has_no_product_effect ack_loss_inspects_same_attempt_without_resend http_2xx_without_typed_body_is_unknown; do
              for action in run pass; do
                test "$(jq -sr --arg name "TestIUWS3CrossRepositoryBotEncoder/$name" --arg action "$action" '[.[] | select(.Package=="github.com/example/autostream-discord-bot/internal/audioforward" and .Test==$name and .Action==$action)] | length' "$RUNNER_TEMP/iu-cross-repository-$mode.json")" = 1
              done
            done
          done
          git diff --exit-code -- go.mod go.sum
          git -C ../encoder diff --exit-code -- go.mod go.sum
      - name: Preserve cross-repository execution evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: iu-bot-encoder-root-events-${{ github.sha }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/iu-cross-repository-*.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14

  v3-manual-auto-start-hold-checks:
    name: v3-manual-auto-start-hold-checks
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 45
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      GOTOOLCHAIN: local
      GOWORK: 'off'
      GOFLAGS: '-mod=readonly'
      GOTELEMETRY: 'off'
      GOMAXPROCS: '2'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
          submodules: recursive
      - uses: actions/setup-go@b7ad1dad31e06c5925ef5d2fc7ad053ef454303e
        with:
          go-version: '1.26.5'
          check-latest: false
          cache: false
      - name: Resolve DAVE cache key
        id: dave-cache-key
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          vcpkg_root="$PWD/third_party/discordgo/dave/libdave/cpp/vcpkg"
          echo "vcpkg_commit=$(git -C "$vcpkg_root" rev-parse HEAD)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - name: Cache DAVE native build
        id: dave-cache
        uses: actions/cache@1bd1e32a3bdc45362d1e726936510720a7c30a57 # v4.2.0
        with:
          path: |
            third_party/discordgo/dave/libdave/cpp/build
            third_party/discordgo/dave/libdave/cpp/vcpkg/vcpkg
            third_party/discordgo/dave/libdave/cpp/vcpkg/downloads
            third_party/discordgo/dave/libdave/cpp/vcpkg/packages
            third_party/discordgo/dave/libdave/cpp/vcpkg/installed
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-dave-${{ steps.dave-cache-key.outputs.vcpkg_commit }}-${{ hashFiles('third_party/discordgo/dave/libdave/cpp/CMakeLists.txt', 'third_party/discordgo/dave/libdave/cpp/Makefile', 'third_party/discordgo/dave/libdave/cpp/src/**', 'third_party/discordgo/dave/libdave/cpp/includes/**', 'third_party/discordgo/dave/libdave/cpp/vcpkg-alts/**') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-dave-${{ steps.dave-cache-key.outputs.vcpkg_commit }}-
      - name: Required Bot public path and original-request roots with pinned DAVE
        env:
          MSR_DAVE_CACHE_HIT: ${{ steps.dave-cache.outputs.cache-hit }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          bash scripts/ci/msr-native-dave.sh "$RUNNER_TEMP/msr-dave.env"
          source "$RUNNER_TEMP/msr-dave.env"
          bash scripts/ci/msr-checks.sh
      - name: Preserve exact MSR root execution evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a
        with:
          name: manual-auto-start-hold-${{ github.sha }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/msr-*.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14
